dedupe_keys.name: energy sparks school energy monitoring platform

description: Energy Sparks is a web application for examining gas and electricity use in schools. The README says it combines consumption data with interventions and teaching materials to help staff and students see changes in energy use. Operators load readings for participating schools; outputs include usage displays and comparisons that may reveal the effect of an action such as changing lighting. Geographic coverage follows schools enrolled by a deployment, with a focus on the United Kingdom. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the application code; access to individual school meter data is separate. A limitation is that a before-and-after change can also reflect weather, occupancy or meter errors, so the app alone does not establish causal energy savings. It can supply building demand profiles or intervention context for school and district energy simulations. The related ERA5 catalogue record can supply weather covariates. No school data or app build was downloaded.
